name: agent-task-player
description: Orchestrate AI coding agents from VS Code. Build plans, hit Play, and let Claude, Codex, Gemini, or Ollama execute — with multi-agent review, auto-fix, smart planning, and GitHub integration.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No plan loaded.

Run a quick task with one prompt:
[Run Prompt](command:agentTaskPlayer.runPrompt)

Or create a full plan:
[Smart Plan (auto-detect)](command:agentTaskPlayer.smartNewPlan)
[Browse Templates](command:agentTaskPlayer.newPlanFromTemplate)
[New Empty Plan](command:agentTaskPlayer.newPlan)

Already have a plan?
[Open Plan File](command:agentTaskPlayer.openPlan)
[Switch Plan](command:agentTaskPlayer.switchPlan)

Recent plans are available from Switch Plan.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic API direct (no CLI required, requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
agentTaskPlayer.defaultEngine.description: Default agent engine to use for tasks.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.codex.command.description: Path or command name for the Codex CLI.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.codex.autoApprov.description: Auto-approve file operations (passes --full-auto to Codex CLI).

agentTaskPlayer.engines.claude.command.description: Path or command name for Claude Code CLI.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.claude.args.description: Extra arguments for Claude Code CLI.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.claude.autoAppro.description: Auto-approve file operations (passes --dangerously-skip-permissions to Claude CLI). Required for non-interactive execution.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.gemini.command.description: Path or command name for Gemini CLI.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.ollama.command.description: Path or command name for Ollama CLI.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.custom.args.description: Custom engine arguments. Use {prompt} as placeholder.

agentTaskPlayer.fallbackEngine.description: Backup engine to switch to when the primary engine hits a rate limit. Leave empty to disable auto-fallback.

agentTaskPlayer.autoplayDelay.description: Delay (ms) between tasks during autoplay. Set to 0 for instant chaining.

agentTaskPlayer.parallelPlaylists.description: Number of playlists to run concurrently. Set to 1 for sequential (default). Higher values run independent playlists in parallel.

agentTaskPlayer.taskTimeoutMs.description: Per-task timeout in milliseconds (default 30 minutes). Override per-task with task.timeoutMs. Profile timeouts: fast=10min, balanced=30min, quality=45min.

agentTaskPlayer.haltOnBrokenBaseline.description: When a task has a verifyCommand and the pre-flight baseline check fails (tests already broken before the agent runs), halt execution instead of proceeding. Prevents agents from running against a broken foundation. Set to false to proceed with a warning instead.

agentTaskPlayer.issueRepo.description: GitHub repo (owner/repo) where MOAG bug reports are filed via the Report Bug button. Example: myorg/moag. Leave blank to prompt each time.

agentTaskPlayer.issueSync.enabled.description: When true, MOAG polls GitHub for new issues with the configured label and automatically adds them as tasks to the active plan.

agentTaskPlayer.issueSync.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (in milliseconds) to poll GitHub for new issues. Minimum 60 000 ms (1 minute). Default is 300 000 ms (5 minutes).

agentTaskPlayer.issueSync.label.description: GitHub issue label that triggers auto-import. Only issues with this label are pulled into the plan.

agentTaskPlayer.issueSync.postComments.description: When true, MOAG posts progress comments to GitHub issues as tasks start, complete, or fail.

agentTaskPlayer.testTool.description: Default tool used for the TTT (Time to Test) phase

agentTaskPlayer.testToolCommand.description: Shell command to run when testTool is set to custom (e.g. npx playwright test)

agentTaskPlayer.costBudgetUsd.description: Estimated cost budget in USD for a run. Set to 0 to disable budget warnings.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.maxFixIterations.description: Maximum number of fix playlists the PRD verification loop may generate before halting for a human.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.gateCommands.description: Shell commands that must exit 0 before the PRD loop asks a model anything. Empty = auto-detect from package.json scripts or the detected test framework.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.gateTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each PRD loop gate command (default 10 minutes).

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.maxDiffChars.description: Character budget for the diff evidence handed to the verification model.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.onManualGate.description: What the PRD loop does when a manual ship gate is waiting: halt for human approval, or skip the gate and continue.

enumDescriptions: Run browser UAT when Playwright or Cypress is detected; skip silently when it is not, leaving the verdict to the repository gates and the model.

Browser UAT must run and pass. If no tooling is detected, or no sandbox URL can be prepared, verification FAILS. On a repo without provisioned browsers this fails every iteration, and with --fix it costs one fix-generation model call before the no-progress guard catches it.
agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.uat.mode.description: Whether the PRD verification loop runs a browser UAT gate against a live sandbox.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.uat.command.description: Explicit browser UAT command. Overrides Playwright/Cypress auto-detection. Empty = auto-detect.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.uat.specPath.description: Spec file or directory the browser UAT gate should run. Empty = the tool's default suite.

agentTaskPlayer.prdLoop.uat.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the browser UAT gate (default 15 minutes). Separate from prdLoop.gateTimeoutMs because a browser suite is slower than a unit test run.

agentTaskPlayer.browser.playwrightVersio.description: Playwright version installed by the "MOAG: Provision Browsers" command.

agentTaskPlayer.maxHistoryEntries.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep.

agentTaskPlayer.maxHistoryStorageBytes.description: Maximum serialized history storage size in bytes. Oldest entries are trimmed when exceeded.

agentTaskPlayer.maxRunSessionStorageByte.description: Maximum serialized run session storage size in bytes. Oldest sessions are trimmed when exceeded.

agentTaskPlayer.failSafeMode.description: Stability-first mode for low-memory environments. Forces sequential execution and disables auto-fix/full-auto retries.

enumDescriptions: Claude, fast model, 3min timeout, no auto-fix — ship fast
Claude, balanced model, 10min timeout, auto-fix on — default
Claude, deep model, 20min timeout, auto-fix on — ship right
Ollama (local), fast model, 5min timeout, no auto-fix — zero cost
agentTaskPlayer.executionProfile.description: Execution profile that controls engine, model, timeout, and auto-fix behavior. Switch between 'ship fast' and 'ship right' modes.

agentTaskPlayer.autoFix.description: When a task fails, automatically analyze the error and retry with a repair prompt. The AI agent reviews what went wrong and attempts to fix it.

agentTaskPlayer.autoTest.description: Automatically run the project test suite after each agent task completes. If tests fail, auto-fix is triggered.

agentTaskPlayer.fullAuto.description: Full Auto mode: agent writes code → tests run → auto-fix if tests fail → repeat until green. Enables autoTest and autoFix together with up to 3 fix cycles.

agentTaskPlayer.showTaskNotifications.description: Show task completion and failure notifications when the dashboard is not visible.

agentTaskPlayer.autoModelSelection.description: Automatically select the best model for each task based on complexity analysis.

agentTaskPlayer.defaultReasoningPreset.description: Default reasoning preset for model selection. 'auto' analyzes task complexity to pick the best model.

agentTaskPlayer.roles.enabled.description: Inject the expert-role charter for playlists and tasks that declare a role. Disable to run every task as a generic agent without editing plan files.

agentTaskPlayer.promptRulesEnabled.description: Inject execution rules into agent task prompts (best-practice guardrails). Disable to send raw prompts only.

agentTaskPlayer.promptRules.default:
[EXECUTION RULES]
- Work within the existing codebase patterns and conventions
- Do not delete or overwrite files unless explicitly asked
- Run existing tests after making changes to verify nothing is broken
- If you encounter an error, fix it before moving on
- Commit logical units of work with descriptive messages
- Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones
[/EXECUTION RULES]
agentTaskPlayer.promptRules.description: System-level instruction block injected before each agent task prompt. Customize or clear to remove.

agentTaskPlayer.promptSnippets.enabled.description: Auto-inject prompt snippets (marked as auto-inject) into agent task prompts. Disable to skip snippet injection.

agentTaskPlayer.context.enabled.description: Master switch for auto-context injection into task prompts.

agentTaskPlayer.context.planOverview.description: Include plan roadmap showing task statuses and current position.

agentTaskPlayer.context.priorTaskOutputs.description: Include stdout from dependency task executions.

agentTaskPlayer.context.allPriorOutputs.description: Output chaining — include ALL prior playlist task outputs (not just dependencies). Enables each task to see what previous tasks produced.

agentTaskPlayer.context.projectState.description: Auto-scan and include README, package.json, and file tree.

agentTaskPlayer.context.changedFiles.description: List files changed by prior tasks with attribution.

agentTaskPlayer.context.cumulativeProgre.description: Include summary of completed tasks with file change counts.

agentTaskPlayer.context.relevantFiles.description: Auto-detect file paths mentioned in the task prompt and include their content as context.

agentTaskPlayer.context.maxFileContextCh.description: Maximum characters for auto-included relevant file content. Files are skipped once this budget is exhausted.

agentTaskPlayer.context.maxContextChars.description: Maximum characters for the context section. Low-priority sections are dropped first.

agentTaskPlayer.context.maxOutputPerTask.description: Maximum characters per prior task stdout output.

agentTaskPlayer.context.maxPriorTasks.description: Maximum number of prior task outputs to include in context. Most recent tasks are kept first.

agentTaskPlayer.context.fileTreeDepth.description: File tree scan depth for project state context.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.claude.extendedT.description: When enabled, instructs Claude to use extended step-by-step thinking for complex tasks. Increases token usage but improves output quality.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.apiKey.description: Anthropic API key for the direct API engine. If empty, falls back to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.model.description: Model ID for the Anthropic API engine (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-7).

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.maxTok.description: Maximum output tokens per Anthropic API response.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.extend.description: Enable real extended thinking via the Anthropic API (claude-3-7+ models). Claude reasons deeply before producing output — significantly improves single-pass accuracy on complex tasks.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.thinki.description: Token budget allocated to the extended thinking phase. Higher values allow deeper reasoning.

agentTaskPlayer.engines.anthropic.multiT.description: Maintain conversation history across tasks in the same playlist. Claude remembers previous tasks' context, improving coherence in multi-step plans.

agentTaskPlayer.git.autoCommit.description: Put each run on its own branch and commit after every task that passes. Turns a long unattended run into reviewable increments. Refuses to start when the working tree is dirty, when HEAD is detached, or outside a git repository. Never pushes.

agentTaskPlayer.git.branchPrefix.description: Branch namespace used by agentTaskPlayer.git.autoCommit. Each run gets <prefix><plan-slug>-<run-id>.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with MOAG
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to automate your AI coding workflow — define task playlists and run them with any coding agent CLI.

steps.title: Install a Coding Agent CLI
steps.description:
MOAG **automatically detects** installed CLIs and sets your default engine on first launch.

You need at least one AI coding agent CLI installed on your system. Pick one and install it globally:

**Claude Code** (recommended):
```
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
```

Or: [Codex](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex) · [Gemini CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/gemini-cli) · [Ollama](https://ollama.com)

Verify it works by running ``claude -p "say hello"`` in your terminal.

[Re-run Engine Detection](command:agentTaskPlayer.detectEngines)

steps.title: Open the MOAG Panel
steps.description:
Click the **rocket icon** $(rocket) in the Activity Bar on the left side of VS Code. This opens the MOAG panel with two sections:

- **Plan** — your playlists and tasks
- **History** — past execution logs

[Open MOAG Panel](command:workbench.view.extension.agentTaskPlayer)

media.altText: MOAG panel in the activity bar

steps.title: Create Your First Plan
steps.description:
A **plan** is a JSON file that holds your task playlists. Click the button below to create one:

[Create New Plan](command:agentTaskPlayer.newPlan)

Or open the example plan from the ``examples/`` folder with **Open Plan File**.

steps.title: Add a Playlist and Tasks
steps.description:
A **playlist** is a phase/group (e.g., "Setup", "Features", "Testing"). Each playlist contains **tasks** — the prompts you want the AI agent to execute.

1. Click **+** in the Plan panel toolbar to add a playlist
2. Click **+** on the playlist to add a task
3. Enter a **name** and a **prompt** — the instruction for the AI

[Add Playlist](command:agentTaskPlayer.addPlaylist)

Or edit the ``.agent-plan.json`` file directly — changes are picked up automatically.

media.altText: Adding playlists and tasks to a plan

steps.title: Hit Play!
steps.description:
Click the **Play** $(play) button in the Plan panel toolbar. Here's what happens:

1. Extension checks if your CLI is installed (warns if not)
2. Sends the first task's prompt to the agent CLI
3. The agent works on your project files
4. Output streams live in the Dashboard
5. Moves to the next task automatically

[Play](command:agentTaskPlayer.play) · [Open Dashboard](command:agentTaskPlayer.showDashboard)

Use **Pause** $(debug-pause) to hold between tasks, or **Stop** $(debug-stop) to abort.

steps.title: Level Up: Dependencies, Retries & Templates
steps.description:
Once you're comfortable, explore these power features:

- **Dependencies** — ``"dependsOn": ["task-id"]`` ensures order
- **Retries** — ``"retryCount": 1`` retries failed tasks
- **Parallel** — ``"parallel": true`` on a playlist runs tasks concurrently
- **Verify** — ``"verifyCommand": "npm test"`` validates results
- **Templates** — right-click a task → **Save as Template** for reuse
- **Import/Export** — share plans with your team

[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22agentTaskPlayer%22)
